title: Скорая поперёк зелёного
adaptation: Signalised junction: south/north green, east/west red. Red sedan waits at the south stop line on green. White ambulance (game van, red stripes, two alternating blue beacons) from the east crosses straight west on its red with beacons and siren on; the siren is heard from the first frame, quietly under the voice. Red gives way, then proceeds on its green.
